build_zimage_pipeline_config: build a ZImagePipelineConfig dataclass instance with DiT, VAE, and Qwen3 text encoder configs for image generation
tokenize_zimage_prompts: tokenize text prompts for ZImage using apply_chat_template with max_length 512 and return PyTorch tensors
shard_latents_for_sp: shard 5D latent tensors across spatial parallel ranks along the selected H or W axis
gather_latents_for_sp: gather spatially sharded latents across ranks using all_gather and concatenate back into a single tensor
get_zimage_freqs_cis: build rotary embedding frequency/cis tensors for caption and image position IDs with sequence length padding
